methods.monthly_climatology: Fixed mean observations by target-start calendar month; initial released history only.
methods.monthly_static: Add initial-history observed-minus-raw mean by target-start month; clip at zero. Never update.
methods.expanding_shrinkage: Update monthly observed-minus-raw residuals from released observations, shrink to all-month residual with12pseudo-observations.
methods.rolling_seasonal_bias: Residual correction from released cases within previous3years and cyclic target-date distance<=45days, triangular seasonalweights,12pseudo-observations of rolling all-season bias.
methods.adaptive_ridge: Per-cell causal exponentially weighted ridge of rainfall/20 on intercept,raw/20,annualsin/cos andrawinteractions;3yearhalflife,ridge10towardrawforecast,interceptpenalty0.1.
methods.adaptive_ensemble: Online mixture of monthly_static/rolling_seasonal_bias/adaptive_ridge. Equal initial weights; losses update only when a previously issued forecast is released. Squared error/400,learningrate0.1,cumulative loss clipped percase at25,10%uniformweightfloor.

selection: No hyperparameter search or selection. All seven predeclared methods are retained on both splits.
static_baseline: Fixed at each episode initialization using all then-released observations; final initialization legitimately includes released development observations.
publication_claim: Local causal methods, no claim of replicating a published algorithm.
